column1: # The one floating-point contract for every Laplace build: Native, Engine, PostgreSQL, PostGIS and every dependency,
# on Linux and Windows. The same input gives the same bits on every machine.
# Read by toolchain/laplace.cmake (CMake), and by setup.sh and setup.ps1 for Meson native files and autotools CFLAGS.
# Columns: what (compile, link, nobuiltin), driver (gnu: icx/icpx/icx-cc; msvc: icx-cl on Windows; gcc: gcc or clang,
# A nobuiltin row is a libm function: the compiler may not fold it at build time with the build host's libm, turn it
# into an SVML vector call or a vendor intrinsic; every call reaches laplace-math (core-math, correctly rounded).
# Measured with icx 2026.1.1 on both machines (2026-10-04): the default is fast math, FMA contraction and SVML; the
# precise flags remove those but cos(0.5) is still folded at build time until -fno-builtin-cos; on Linux an icx-built
# object links libimf and libsvml unless -no-intel-lib=libimf,libsvml.
# Intel's math libraries (libimf, libsvml) and libirng are not linked; libirc (_intel_fast_memcpy/memset, which icx
# emits for copies: exact) and its libintlc stay, because separate compile and link steps need them.
# Windows keeps libmmd for exact operations only (sqrt, round, fmin/fmax, ldexp, the fenv calls): icx's headers
# declare those as imports from it, and the UCRT defines feraiseexcept only inline. Every icx object names libmmd as a
# default library, and link.exe can search a default library before a library named later on the command line (PostGIS
# topology took sin, cos and atan2 from libmmd that way), so a link drops it (/NODEFAULTLIB:libmmd) and names it
# explicitly after laplace-math. The fingerprint's override check proves it per binary (math/test/determinism.c).
# x86-64-v2 is the baseline every build is compiled for (Wiki: Sequence 2.1, 3.3): one binary runs on every machine.
# The higher levels (v3: AVX2, FMA, BMI2; AVX-VNNI; v4: AVX-512; AVX-512 VNNI) are Laplace-Native's kernels, each in
# its own translation unit and chosen at run time. With contraction and reassociation off, vectorizing does not change
# results, so the ISA level is speed only.
